answer: At dawn each agent posts a signed bond to a decentralized ledger; the bond amount is locked behind a smart‑contract bridge that only releases funds when a quorum of neighboring agents on the river of gossip verifies the node’s behavior. If a peer detects a duplicate identity, it triggers a challenge that forces the bond to be slashed, costing the attacker the full stake. Because the cost scales with the number of forged IDs, a Sybil flood becomes economically prohibitive.
